New protocol: everyone in a session needs 0.11.0 (it doesn't play with 0.10.1); keep a copy of the session file if you might go back to 0.10.1
Every game builds the same enemy: one roll per leveled NPC for the session, legendaries included (host settings sNpcLevel, sLegendaryDifficulty)
A mine a friend walks onto gives both of you the full warning beep instead of going off at once
Catching up a friend's main quest no longer pulls a joiner into Kellogg's memory
A leveled NPC that only a friend's game has, like a Mr Gutsy on the road, now shows up in yours
A teleport to a far-away friend lands next to them, and its autosave waits until you stand on the ground
Fixed starts where the player had no input at all (no walking, looking or shooting)
A sneaking friend sneak-walks instead of gliding crouched
A late joiner or a reload sees how hurt a friend's NPCs are instead of full health
A piece a player built that their save no longer has is taken out of every friend's game
Full notes on GitHub
